hypothesis: Within the first completed hour, the volume share accompanying upward versus downward SOXX minute moves may distinguish broad intraday buying from continued selling before the existing Stage1 10:32 recovery decision. This is distinct from prior-session signed volume proposed for the 09:29 allocation head and from existing recovery early-return, range and unsigned log-volume fields.
parent: Frozen Stage1 allocation/action/risk/recovery; source-only qualification does not alter parent, fit a model, read action-value labels, or run an account.

feature.name: SOXX_first_hour_signed_volume_pressure
feature.formula: For each trade date, require exactly the 60 right-labelled 09:31..10:30 one-minute SOXX bars. On t=09:32..10:30, calculate sign(log(close_t/close_t_minus_1))*volume_t and divide their sum by the sum of those 59 volumes. Zero returns contribute 0 to numerator; no clipping, smoothing, threshold or lookback selection.
feature.validity: Every one of the 60 bars must have finite positive close, finite nonnegative volume and price_valid==1, no duplicate or missing minute. Denominator over 59 signed bars must be positive. Any failure produces unknown for the entire day, with date retained.
feature.assumed_available_at: 10:31 America/New_York on the trade date, one minute after the 10:30 completed right-labelled bar; historical first receipt and finality are unqualified
feature.receiver_decision_at: 10:32 America/New_York on the same trade date

novelty_boundary: Original Stage1 recovery FEATURE_COLUMNS has early SOXX/SOXL return, range and log total volume, but no intrahour volume-weighted direction. The earlier 09:29 allocation-source preflight stopped because 2011-2018 minute history is absent; this 10:32 action receiver has a structurally different 2018-2022 source-qualified training cohort. No closed path-area, basket-lead, signed-semivariance or FINRA result is reopened.
stop: One source construction and coverage audit only. If training/held coverage is below the fixed 99% requirement, stop with exact missing/invalid dates; do not impute, filter stress days, change minute cutoffs or train on a chosen subset. If source gate passes, a separate fixed incremental test must compare with every existing Stage1 recovery feature on mature same-state beta0.6 net action-value labels before any complete 0bp account.
